worldcombat.skill.pluck.summary: Peck with a long beak that reaches far and high (even airborne targets); if the target holds a Berry, tear it off and eat it at once, taking the effect for yourself. No closing in, no chewing - a quick, shallow swallow.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.use.0: Peck from afar and eat the target's Berry
worldcombat.skill.pluck.use.1: Reach an airborne target with the beak
worldcombat.skill.pluck.use.2: Turn the target's Berry at once into your own healing or boost
worldcombat.skill.pluck.description.0: The peck deals about %1$s Flying contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.description.1: The beak reaches %1$s blocks along your aim and up to %2$s blocks high; the nearest non-friendly in the corridor is struck.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.description.2: A pecked Berry is swallowed at once at %1$s times effect.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.swoop.on: Swoop on: reach x1.3, lift x1.4, cooldown +6 ticks; you reach farther and higher at the cost of a x0.88 hit.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.swoop.off: Swoop off: normal reach and lift, hit x1.08.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.growth.0: At level %1$s, the peck power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.growth.1: At level %1$s, the peck power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.preference.swoop: On: reach x1.3, lift x1.4, cooldown +6, hit x0.88. Off: normal reach and lift, hit x1.08.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.preference.ai.ma: Only reach out within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.preference.ai.le: On: it will leave its station under a hold order to peck. Off: it only does so when the target is already in reach.
worldcombat.skill.pluck.preference.ai.be: On: only used when the target carries a Berry, as a dedicated eater. Off: bare-handed targets are pecked as ordinary ranged attacks.
world_combat.move.pluck.text.spike: Pricked by a spike in the Berry
world_combat.move.pluck.text.none: The pulp had no special effect
